actions: Read the terms on app.infinifi.xyz once (confirm US access).
Mint iUSD with USDC on Base (cheaper gas) and stake to siUSD; lock to liUSD only for a lock you would accept losing access to for its full term.
Check points weekly on app.infinifi.xyz/points; do nothing else (no loops, no leverage).

plan.claim: At TGE: claim, sell 50-75% in the first days, keep the rest only if the vault stays useful.

rows.note: eligible count; only 191,391 claimed, unclaimed TIA was reallocated to claimers (per-claimer value ~3x higher)
Season 1 stakedrop 6.75% of 1.674B; 'more than 280,000'; transferable Oct 1 2024

verdict: More wallets -> lower $ per wallet: Spearman rho = -0.458 (n=15); not significant at ~5% (critical |rho| ~0.52).
Bigger crowds did NOT come with proportionally bigger pools: rho(wallets, pool $) = 0.331.
Crowd size vs 90-day price change after TGE: rho = -0.25 (n=15).
caveats: Wallet counts are eligible (not claimed) addresses; TIA had only 191k claimers, so its per-claimer value was ~3x the per-eligible figure.
Per-wallet is a mean; distributions are tiered/skewed, so a typical wallet got less than the mean.
These are famous drops (survivorship): many points programs never paid at all, which no sample here captures.
Price = first DefiLlama daily price on/after the claim date; some TGE dates are approximate (marked assumed).
Hype is proxied only by crowd size; there is no free historical hype measure for these launches.

method.rank: Tiers by your jurisdiction (seed.you): allowed, then terms unknown (check before farming), then restricted (never use a VPN), then base-case net EV = EV - (time + fees + opportunity cost + expected loss). ROI = EV / cost.
method.scenarios: lo = pessimistic end of every input (incl. larger crowd and higher costs), hi = optimistic end; base = middle. They are not probabilities.
method.saturation: Score 0-100 (higher = less crowded): 45% expected pool $ per participant (log, $10 -> 0, $10k -> 1), 35% crowd size (log, 1k -> 1, ~3M -> 0; bucket default when unknown), 20% quiet on X (7-day post count, log). Renormalised over available parts.
method.refresh: Weekly: scripts/airdrop_roi_weekly.sh (prices, TVL, calibration). Seed facts and X counts are re-checked by hand (dates shown).
